pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/lib/judge/calibration.ts:340 The calibration guard that 'fails the build on enforced-fail' gets its verdict from a per-machine log outside the tree, so the same commit passes on a clean clone (unrun) and fails on a machine that has run a calibration. Its input is not a function of the tree it gates, yet it blocks.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/judge/calibration.ts:340 The guard test asserts not enforced-fail over latestCalibrationRun() read from ~/.pof. It is a blocking verdict on input that lives outside the tree, and it never splits into deterministic and measured halves.

src/lib/judge/rubrics.ts:6 No test ties DIMENSIONS or the rubric text to RUBRIC_VERSION. The only test is judge.test.ts `RUBRIC_VERSION >= 2`. CONTENT_HASH_SCHEME's 'bump on ANY change to serialization' (contentHash.ts:54) is also prose only: payload.test pins the key list but neither pins the canonical form nor forces the bump.
src/lib/judge/calibration.ts:16 Names the exit path from standing to build failure, and the guard test asserts exactly that.
src/lib/judge/calibration.ts:23 A missing or empty instrument is a named not-proven standing, never green.
src/lib/judge/calibration.ts:22 Below the sample floor the rate is reported, not certified.
src/lib/judge/verdictStanding.ts:32 Reporting surfaces count the same CONDEMNING_PROVENANCE set that acceptance enforces.
src/lib/judge/contentHash.ts:48 The hash exclusion list is derived from the judge's strip list (NON_CONTENT_KEYS), so the binding is to the content the judge actually read.
src/lib/judge/verdictStanding.ts:53 Closed standing vocabulary (current/stale/superseded/unknown), with an explicit unknown instead of a blank.
src/lib/judge/dimensions.ts:21 Measured misfires were fixed by narrowing the rubric routing, not by deleting the bar.
src/lib/judge/dimensions.ts:27 The escape is scoped to named pairs, not patterns, so it cannot silence other steps.
src/app/api/judge-verdicts/route.ts:116 The producer's self-stated 'pass' is re-checked against its score and rubric at the write door before it is stored (route.ts:108-110).
src/lib/craft/craftCell.ts:62 The A-axis craft lens and the R-axis judge share an LLM substrate. The craft side is structurally display-only and cannot move a grade.
src/lib/craft/craftCell.ts:305 Gauges are keyed to the lens they were scored under, so relabelling cannot dodge a lens.
src/lib/judge/rubrics.ts:20 A mass of 'invented reference' findings was traced to the harness, not the content, and the affected verdicts were made provisional.

pairs.registryProposal: blocking-by-input-determinism names two input classes: the tree and an external feed. A third is a machine-local measurement log the gate itself writes, as with a calibration history kept outside the repo. It is neither tree-determined nor an outside feed and may deserve an explicit rule: commit the evidence, or keep the gate advisory.
